entries.title: Hyperion Industries
entries.content: Hyperion Industries builds Stratified Systems: coherent operational systems across business logic, human workflow, agents, applications and data, identity and governance, infrastructure, and physical operations. Continuity is an engineering property across changes in people, vendors, devices, models, locations, and failures. The economic promise is more useful capability from the people and infrastructure an organization already has. Public claims preserve maturity labels and never imply access to private operator systems, records, source code, telemetry, or execution authority.

entries.title: Operating doctrine
entries.content: Hyperion's public doctrine is: facts are source-bound, meaning is context-bound, and actions are authority-bound. Each lane captures state, preserves provenance, exposes context, gates authority, routes approved action, and learns from reality contact. AI may assist, surface, and recommend; a public page cannot borrow private execution authority and the human operator decides.

entries.title: The Forge
entries.content: The Forge is an inquiry-led lane for custom PCs, simulation rigs, local AI boxes, upgrades, and deployment-ready workstations. The public Forge Concierge guides visitors one question at a time through workload, room, budget, service, and tradeoff posture, then holds the resulting brief for human review. Its product neighborhoods and counterfactual previews are not quotes, compatibility verdicts, inventory promises, configurations, or orders.

entries.title: Hyperion Card Studio
entries.content: Hyperion Card Studio covers digital identity cards and physical NFC cards. The digital card is free. Public catalog posture lists PVC cards from $39, metal cards from $89, Pro at $9 per month or $90 per year, and Team pricing as custom. Payment and fulfillment remain operator-reviewed through draft invoices; there is no public cart or checkout on the Hyperion site.

entries.title: Public systems posture
entries.content: CHR0N.OS is the public stable-beta lane for classification, provenance, lineage, recovery, and temporal context under operator custody. Mnem.OS is in development as a continuity layer for snapshots, histories, recovery, and long-horizon context under owner control. Kosm.OS, Log.OS, Synth.OS, Eid.OS, Eth.OS, and Myth.OS are architecture, concept, or research lanes and must not be described as shipped products.

entries.title: Contact and intake
entries.content: Hyperion begins with a bounded assessment of the objective, current system, existing tools, failure, budget, deadline, success criteria, and whether strategy, implementation, or both are needed. A submitted signal begins operator review; it is not a quote, contract, deployment, access grant, or automation promise. Visitors must not submit credentials, secrets, private archives, restricted logs, or sensitive operational records.

entries.title: Founding operators
entries.content: Victor Amani is the founder and systems architect behind Hyperion Industries' local-first infrastructure direction. Keshawn Rowe is the founding operator focused on operations, deployment, field systems, build intake, and client handoff. Public profiles describe responsibility without exposing private records or operator controls.

entries.title: Personalized digital products
entries.content: Hyperion is preparing three deterministic products: Agent Policy ($19), Flight Pack ($29), and Local + Frontier Routing Starter Kit ($49), with free representative samples. Each package is configured from buyer-supplied constraints. Checkout, payment, entitlement, and fulfillment remain disabled while sandbox preparation is incomplete; the site does not currently take payment for these products.
